name: Nagercoil
pointBasis: Immutable pending-queue WUP 2025 coordinate, copied without adjustment.
registryBasis: The official Kanniyakumari District Administration page for Land Records Aregister/Chitta identifies Nagercoil as the district collectorate city and links citizens to Tamil Nadu Survey & Settlement services for Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-Register, verification and urban land-survey maps. This establishes an official local/district land-record custodian and service route, not parcel geometry access or title conclusions.
blocker: No safe anonymous parcel identifier plus full native geometry response was obtained. The official district page and state e-Services page document land-record and urban survey-map services, while the current TNGIS generic API documentation exposes only a district extent example; direct live API/service attempts were unavailable or timed out. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official local registry custody is evidenced, but anonymous parcel geometry, schema/CRS and citywide coverage remain unverified. The exact WUP point was not shifted and was not used to infer absence.

technicalBlocker: The documented TNGIS generic API host could not be resolved from the shell during bounded GET attempts; eservices.tn.gov.in timed out in the shell but was readable through the web retrieval layer; tamilnilam.tn.gov.in/citizen timed out through web retrieval. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA or TLS bypass were used.
remainingUncertainty: Whether TamilNilam, Collabland or a TNGIS-backed official viewer exposes a public anonymous parcel geometry endpoint for Nagercoil, and whether urban Nagercoil is covered by such a layer, remain unknown.
